resources.string: Capture what interests you.\nUnderstand what you saved.
Recording · stop when the content finishes

Tap Screenshot and approve Android’s prompt. Return to the screen you want, tap the pig, then Take screenshot. The controls hide briefly and a PNG is saved here. Screenshots do not need audio permission. Some apps hide protected content.

Capture permitted video or audio from Douyin, WeChat Channels, or other apps. Set up capture first, return to your video, then tap Record now. Nothing is recorded while Ready. Choose a single app in Android’s dialog for cleaner clips; entire-screen recordings can include floating controls. Some apps block capture.

Allow Copig to display over other apps once. A small pig stays at the screen edge. Tap it to open the buttons; drag it to move. Tap Record, approve Android’s prompt, then tap Record now at your video. The controls shrink back after recording starts or stops. Tap the pig again to Stop.
Allow Copig to display over other apps in Android Settings to use floating controls.
Tap the pig at the screen edge to open recording controls.
Copig · drag the pig to move; × shrinks the controls
Ready · tap Record now or Take screenshot. Setup expires after 4 minutes.
Drag the pig to move floating controls
Saved clips stay on this phone until you share them.
Audio appears silent. Check playback; the source app may block audio capture.
Android requires audio permission to capture playback. Copig does not record the microphone. If permission is blocked, enable it in Android app settings.
No compatible app is installed. Save a copy to Files or install a media player.
